The '''Dessain family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family who created [[Dessain Mining]]. The family included [[Eomin Dessain]] and his daughter [[Oma Dessain]] who participated in negotiations on [[Zerist]] between their company's management and their [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="Eruption" />
